summary: Iteration 25 - Operacional module and related features testing complete. 17/17 backend tests passed. All frontend tests passed. Fixed bug where custo field was not being saved in ofertas create/update endpoints.

issues: Custo column shows R$ 0,00 for all rows - this is expected since custo field was just added and existing ofertas don't have custo values set

frontend_tests.planilha_operacional_page: PASS - Page loads with all indicators (Receita, Custo, Lucro, Margem)
frontend_tests.planilha_search: PASS - Accent-insensitive search works ('alvaro' finds 'Álvaro Da Silva Junior')
frontend_tests.planilha_filters: PASS - Status and canal filters work
frontend_tests.planilha_import_button: PASS - Import Excel button visible (admin only)
frontend_tests.planilha_inline_editing: PASS - Clicking on Obs cell opens input field
frontend_tests.sidebar_collapsible_groups: PASS - All 6 groups (Operacao, Clientes & Linhas, Financeiro, Cadastros, Rede, Sistema) expand/collapse
frontend_tests.ofertas_custo_field: PASS - Custo field visible in form with lucro/margem preview
frontend_tests.clientes_canal_observacoes: PASS - Canal (select) and Observacoes fields visible in form
frontend_tests.portal_page: PASS - Portal do Cliente page loads correctly (not black screen)

GET /api/operacional/planilha.details: Returns linhas array with all fields + resumo object with receita/custo/lucro/margem

PATCH /api/operacional/linha/{id}.details: Updates observacoes, proxima_recarga, canal (updates cliente), status_chip

GET /api/operacional/export.details: Returns Excel file (.xlsx) with proper headers

POST /api/operacional/importar-excel.details: Accepts multipart form-data, returns {imported, updated, errors, total_errors}

POST/PUT /api/clientes with canal/observ.details: Canal and observacoes fields persist correctly

Frontend /operacional.details: Page loads, table shows data, indicators visible, search/filters work, inline editing works

Frontend /portal.details: Portal do Cliente page loads correctly (not black screen)

Excel export uses openpyxl with proper styling and 2 sheets (Planilha + Resumo)
